dictation: I got corn at the store

A.text: At the farm, Sam spots a horse. / The horse has a short, dark mane. / "Can I ride the horse?" asked Sam. / "Yes, hold on well," said his mom. / Sam gets on, and the horse trots because he holds on well. / Sam has a fun, short ride. / Once he is done, Sam pets the horse and says, "Thank you." / Sam has a whole, fine time at the farm.

B.text: Kate has a list, so she goes to the store. / She gets corn, milk, and a snack from a stand. / Before she is done, she checks her list. / "I got what I came for," said Kate. / She goes to the front and gets a short line. / She is glad she made a trip to the store, because she got what she came for.
